text: Good evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she is 3 months old. Her temperature is 38.4°C. She's been very sleepy this evening, more than usual, she's quite floppy when I lift her and it's hard to rouse her for her feed. The soft spot on the top of her head looks raised and is bulging up when I look at it with her sat up. She also hasn't done a poo for three days and has been grizzly with it. I'd like advice on what to do next please.
